corrected_findings.issue: increment/decrement array lvalue was evaluated twice
corrected_findings.correction: resolve the lvalue once, then read and update the captured cell

corrected_findings.issue: local static/extern storage did not have C89 lifetime/linkage semantics
corrected_findings.correction: reject unsupported procedure-local static/extern storage during validation; static global storage and function linkage remain supported

corrected_findings.issue: authoring source was parsed and hashed through separate file reads
corrected_findings.correction: capture each unit once as bytes; decode and hash that same capture
corrected_findings.regression: a private authored source file is replaced immediately after its first read; the exported hash must still identify the bytes parsed

corrected_findings.issue: external nes.lib was linked without capturing/hash-binding it
corrected_findings.correction: capture once into the private build, link the captured copy and record its length/SHA256

limits: This review and finite regression evidence do not prove arbitrary C89 programs or whole-game equivalence.
The native backend admits only the exact reviewed efficient/baseline procedure bodies and qualified original-ROM binding.
Raw original inputs, native cartridges and detailed traces remain outside Git.
